lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters in approximately vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank, transitioning to a sparser horizontal alignment toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a visible grid-like pattern on the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries, tracking horizontally toward the tail.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are distributed across the first dorsal fin surface, with a higher concentration observed near the posterior trailing edge and lower section of the fin macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) near the ventral region, with one highly visible high-contrast individual below the mid-body.
